newsitem.title: CHINA: China firm to boost ethylene output in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China firm to boost ethylene output in 1997.

text.p: China's Dushanzi Petrochemical is planning to boost ethylene output from a plant in northwestern Xinjiang region to 140,000 tonnes in 1997, up from 120,000 tonnes last year, a company official said on Thursday.
The five billion yuan ($602 million) ethylene plant, which went into operation in early 1996, would also seek to raise production capacity, the official told Reuters by telephone.
Dushanzi Ethylene had in 1996 produced 220,000 tonnes of other petrochemical products such as polyethylene, polypropylene, rubber and plastic film, he said but gave no details.
Chinese officials have said they expect total 1996 ethylene output to exceed 3.0 million tonnes.
